title: Seeded PRNG Sample Demonstrator
description: Derives a seeded sample of k distinct indices from [0, n) under one of three declared PRNG algorithm ids, echoing the algorithm id and a seed commitment in every output, entirely offline. Modes: xoshiro256ss-splitmix64-v1 (decimal integer seed, bit-identical to the proven art-371 generator), xoshiro256ss-splitmix64-sha256str-v1 (UTF-8 string seed, state = SHA-256 digest words) and hmac-drbg-sha256 (64-hex derived seed, the sampler family's DRBG stream). Selection is exactly unbiased: threshold-rejection integer draws driving a partial Fisher-Yates, exactly k accepted draws, no draw cap, n bounded at 1,000,000. Bad seed grammar, unknown algorithm ids and out-of-range n or k are refused with a closed reason code and no sample. Live execution surface for the shared _prng bundle: the kernel carries the bundle verbatim, so its fixtures and property floor exercise the exact bytes other kernels will later inline. It carries no policy and decides nothing.

algorithm_id.description: PRNG algorithm id. Each id has its own seed grammar; the kernel refuses a seed that does not match the declared id's grammar.

seed.description: Declared seed, grammar per algorithm id: decimal integer with absolute value at most 9007199254740991 (xoshiro256ss-splitmix64-v1); non-empty UTF-8 string of at most 256 bytes (xoshiro256ss-splitmix64-sha256str-v1); exactly 64 lowercase hex characters (hmac-drbg-sha256).

Exactly unbiased partial Fisher-Yates selection, no draw cap. Refuses bad seed grammar or out-of-range n/k with a closed reason code.
